'''3B3-21''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] who served in the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] under [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was a part of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] force that swept into [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] capital city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], and later defended the Federation-occupied [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Palace]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] leader, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]], during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. 3B3-21 was later deactivated, along with every other [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] on Naboo, when the Federation's [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] was destroyed.

==Biography==
3B3-21<ref name="ccg" /> was one of the many [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s in [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray's]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]].<ref name="tpm" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Gunray took his force to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], and [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] as a way of protesting against the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate's]] newly passed taxation of trade routes. Soon enough, he had his army [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invade]] Naboo. When the capital city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] was captured, so too was the planet's leader, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]].<ref name="tpm" /> 3B3-21 was originally assigned to escort the captured Queen,<ref name="ccg" /> but the task was eventually carried out by a group of [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|OOM security battle droids]]. Amidala later escaped from the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] thanks to the aid of two [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], but the Federation's occupation of Theed and Naboo continued.<ref name="tpm" />

[[File:3B321battle.png|thumb|left|170px|3B3-21 (left) in battle]]
Later, Amidala was able to [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|mount an attack]] on the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]], where the Viceroy was staying. 3B3-21 was a part of the force that attempted to defend the palace from the Queen's incursion force. He and his fellow [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] fought the Naboo natives in one of the Palace's spacious corridors, but the Queen and her soldiers were able to bypass the droids by scaling an outer wall to reach the level above. Shortly afterward, the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] orbiting Naboo and controlling all Federation droids on the planet was destroyed, which resulted in the instantaneous deactivation of the droids themselves. Amidala was able to capture Gunray, putting an end to the Federation's occupation.<ref name="tpm" />

==Characteristics==
Manufactured by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]],<ref name="db" /> 3B3-21 had [[Color/Legends|white]] plating, [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]],<ref name="tpm" /> [[Gender/Legends|masculine programming]],<ref name="ccg" /> and, like all B1 battle droids, stood 1.91 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="db" /> 3B3-21 was equipped with command programs that allowed him to summon reinforcements to his designated patrol zone. He was able to do this whenever needed.<ref name="ccg" /> 3B3-21 was also equipped with an [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]], which he employed when battling Amidala's incursion force.<ref name="tpm" />

==Behind the scenes==
3B3-21 first appeared in [[George Lucas]]' [[1999]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], as an unnamed battle droid in the climactic stages of the story. The character was later identified in the "[[Theed Palace Limited]]" set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].
